We’re looking for subcontractors for two pieces of the work, and we especially want to hear from Minority- and Women-Owned Business Enterprises […]
item.content:encoded:
Marc Gratch Consulting is bidding as prime on a public-agency WordPress project: the Sacramento Housing and Redevelopment Agency’s RFP 2621-KP, “SHRA Website Accessibility, Hosting, and WordPress Support.” Proposals are due November 30, 2026.

We’re looking for subcontractors for two pieces of the work, and we especially want to hear from Minority- and Women-Owned Business Enterprises (M/WBE).

1. Document remediation. Tagging and fixing PDFs and Microsoft Office files to WCAG 2.1 AA and PDF/UA. We estimate 1,000 to 2,000 pages between January and April 2027, mostly short notices, guides and fillable forms linked from a WordPress site.

2. Independent accessibility re-audit. A yearly WCAG 2.1 AA review of the WordPress site by someone who isn’t on the team maintaining it.

All work is remote. You can quote on either piece or both.

To be considered, email by November 23, 2026 with:

  • Your pricing: per page for standard documents, and for forms or complex tables; per audit for the re-audit
  • Typical turnaround
  • The tools and testing methods you use
  • One or two examples of similar work
  • Your M/WBE certification, if you hold one

Questions are welcome at the same address.

Marc Gratch
Marc Gratch Consulting

item.content:encoded:
Will you be our newest WordPress Sales Support Specialist?

We are looking for a WordPress Sales Support Specialist to promote high-quality WordPress plugins and themes that contribute to the overall success of WPMU DEV products.

You will join an ongoing and expanding team of sales enthusiasts who work collaboratively with all areas of the company to make sure we stand out from the rest!

The person we’re in search of will have intimate knowledge of WordPress and experience using a broad range of plugins and themes and will manage Accounts and Sales-related communications.

We’re looking for a person who will be able to also work on weekends and is available to work on the following schedules:

  • 10:00 pm – 6:00 am UTC
  • 3:00 pm – 11:00 pm UTC

Responsibilities

  • Leads generation
  • Providing support to customers and members by identifying solutions to their WP-related concerns through our communication channels (email, chat)
  • Providing customer service and managing customer accounts
  • Providing product knowledge and promoting WPMU DEV products.
  • Maintaining meticulous CRM hygiene while monitoring and nurturing sales leads through consistent follow-up email correspondence.
  • Managing inbound and outbound sales communications.
  • Conducting Zoom calls with potential and existing clients.

Qualifications

Essential attributes and experience required:

  • Have a really good familiarity with WordPress, including themes and plugins
  • Superb interpersonal skills, including the power to swiftly build rapport with current customers
  • Proven experience in sales and accounts and billing support
  • At least 1-year of experience in any Sales Support position
  • Proficient in English: Verbal and Written
  • Proficient in spreadsheets and data entry
  • Enjoy collaborating with others, and don’t back down from a challenge
  • Typing skills
  • Strong communication skills
  • Love people and love yourself!

We like all staff to be working 40 hours a week, but if you did want to work more hours, that’s also cool with us.

SKILL-SET
WordPress, Customer Support, English language, Communication, Sales, Data entry, Google Sheets

Job benefits

Why Join us?

  • Growth-oriented culture.
  • Excellent compensation with competitive benefits and rejuvenation time-off.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Training, tools and support will be provided to help you to perform your job.
  • Limitless learning opportunities by working with cutting-edge tech stacks and a diverse, talented team.
  • 28 days of paid leave per annum (up to 35 days).
  • Opportunities for paid travel to attend WordCamps and other industry conferences.
  • Long service leaves (3 months off paid) after you’ve been with us for 10 years.
  • Annual bonus based on company growth targets
  • Technology budget that can help you upgrade the tools you use for your job; the longer you serve, the higher the budget.
  • General expenses budget yearly that can be used to help you become more productive; the longer you work, the more you get.

What should i do now?

Download the WordPress Sales Support Specialist Task Sheet (via the apply link), answer those questions, and then submit your application. It’s that simple!

The ability to write in clear English is essential in this role. We are unable to consider applications that fail to demonstrate a high level of written communication.

HIRING PROCESS
Our hiring process includes the task mentioned above, a 2nd task, and an interview with our management team, including a 3rd task. If a candidate successfully passes the interview stage, they will be offered a paid trial of 4-6 weeks before being offered a more permanent role.

Good luck!

item.content:encoded:
As part of Incsub, since 2006, WPMU DEV, with its’ award-winning WordPress plugins, hosting, world-beating support and site management tools, has helped millions of web developers, freelancers and agencies run and grow their businesses.

Are you tech-oriented and love to work from home? Do you like coding and helping people?

Then this is your chance to make a difference. Stop dreaming about tomorrow; join our team at WPMU DEV and let it be the biggest change in your growth today.

Our talented, inspirational team is located globally, with team members working from every continent. Location is unimportant as long as you are available and enthusiastic. Our team members work in shifts, and we aim to provide 24/7 coverage to our customers.

We’re looking for a person that will be able to also work on weekends and be available to work on the following schedules:

  • 4:00 pm – 12:00 am UTC

Responsibilities

At WPMU DEV, we power and host websites used by millions of users every single day. We’re looking for experienced WordPress Support Specialists who can join our team in our quest to offer the best support in the WordPress ecosystem. You’d need to be polite, patient and understanding with our customers.

The role involves:

  • Supporting our awesome members and customers
  • Responding to customers who report issues with their website(s), plugins or hosting services and handling/debugging issues (promptly)
  • Hanging out in the WordPress.org forums – being massively friendly, helpful, and useful
  • Helping customers with their WordPress problems by logging into their websites, diagnosing issues and offering solutions.
  • Writing clear and helpful responses to customer queries via email, chat and our forum.
  • Providing knowledgeable recommendations for solutions to handle customer feature requests.
  • Providing our developers and Second Level Support Team with clear and detailed bug reports for escalation.
  • Properly document & summarize tests or troubleshooting steps for communicating both with customers and colleagues.
  • Assisting with and solving all manner of WordPress questions with style!
  • Being an active part of the Incsub team.

Reach for the skies; we have many challenges and opportunities for those who aspire to do more!

Qualifications

Essential attributes and experience required:

  • At least 2+ years of experience with WordPress.
  • Ability to code using PHP, CSS, MySQL and HTML.
  • Good knowledge of the WordPress platform and WordPress hooks & filters
  • Ability to diagnose WordPress issues by isolating potential factors and providing resolution
  • An understanding of browser console errors and debugging via developer tools
  • Attention to detail and aptitude for problem-solving
  • Great interpersonal communication skills, being kind, supportive, and all-around friendly
  • Being a great team player, keen on working in an expanding, motivated, distributed support team
  • Love for impressive response times, typing speed (it matters), and the ability to produce quality work between deadlines
  • Fluent in English to communicate effectively.
  • Ability to work full-time (40 hours/week)

SKILL-SET
WordPress, Technical Support, Customer Support, Communication, PHP, CSS, MySQL, HTML

Job benefits

Why Join us?

  • Growth-oriented culture.
  • Excellent compensation with competitive benefits and rejuvenation time-off.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Training, tools and support will be provided to help you to perform your job.
  • Limitless learning opportunities by working with cutting-edge tech stacks and a diverse, talented team.
  • 28 days of paid leave per annum (up to 35 days).
  • Opportunities for paid travel to attend WordCamps and other industry conferences.
  • Long service leaves (3 months off paid) after you’ve been with us for 10 years.
  • Annual bonus based on company growth targets
  • Technology budget that can help you upgrade the tools you use for your job; the longer you serve, the higher the budget.
  • General expenses budget yearly that can be used to help you become more productive; the longer you work, the more you get.

What should I do now?

If you would like to be part of our company and feel your values match ours, submit your application along with a copy of your CV and the completed WordPress Support Specialist Task, and we’ll get in touch. It’s that simple!

HIRING PROCESS

Our hiring process includes the attached task (found via the apply link) and an interview with our management team, enclosing a 2nd task. If a candidate successfully passes the interview stage, they will be offered a paid trial of 4-6 weeks before being offered a more permanent role.

Good luck!

* Applications must include the completed task sheet (found via the apply link) to be assessed

V-Outsourcing Business Group is hiring a part-time Full Stack Developer based in Latin America. This is a fully remote role, Monday through Friday, with working hours aligned with Chicago time.

You’ll build and maintain WordPress and Elementor sites, manage domains, hosting, DNS and SSL, and support website and database migrations and REST API integrations. You’ll also communicate with clients in English about technical issues.

A degree, at least one year of relevant experience, and advanced spoken and written English (C1 or equivalent) are required.

To apply, email your résumé in English and one or two portfolio links with the subject Full Stack Developer. Briefly describe what you personally built or implemented. The interview will be conducted in English.

item.content:encoded:
We are seeking a capable WordPress developer for a short-term, paid website development project.

The client is a privately held Canadian management consulting startup.

The project involves developing approximately six pages from completed design storyboards, supplied branding and approved website content.

The mandatory platform is WordPress using the Gutenberg block editor, Kadence Theme and Kadence Blocks.

We are particularly interested in a student, recent graduate or junior freelancer who has already completed professional-quality WordPress websites.

Our anticipated budget is C$2,000–$2,500 on a fixed-price basis, with an immediate start preferred.

The work can be performed remotely.

We would appreciate receiving examples of relevant completed websites, confirmation of experience with Kadence, and an indication of availability.

The client’s identity and detailed project materials will be provided to shortlisted candidates under appropriate confidentiality arrangements.

If you are interested, or can recommend a suitable developer, we would welcome hearing from you.

Thank you.

About the Project

We operate the platform of the International Association of Project Managers (IAPM), which includes several websites, a certification system, and a web-based learning platform.

Our current website is based on a historically developed, custom-built CMS with numerous PHP processes and a MySQL database. The goal is to gradually migrate this platform to WordPress, replacing as many custom developments as possible with established WordPress and WooCommerce solutions.

We are looking for an experienced, German-speaking WordPress developer (m/f/d) with excellent PHP skills to support us in this project.

Project Goal

Our goal is to rebuild our current system (including the website) using WordPress and PHP applications. Afterward, the processes will be gradually migrated from the existing system, and the old processes will be deactivated.

First, existing processes will be analyzed and replaced with standard solutions wherever possible. Custom programming will only be undertaken where technically necessary (this will be discussed and further detailed between the client and contractor at the working level).

During the migration, the old and new systems will operate in parallel. The final switchover will only take place after successful completion of the migration.

Roles and Responsibilities Lead technical planning, website architecture, and […]
item.content:encoded:
WordPress / UX Technical Lead serves as the technical authority responsible for the design, development, user experience, accessibility integration, and implementation of the Columbia County Tourism website. The individual will lead discovery, information architecture, WordPress development, UX optimization, API integrations, testing, deployment, and technical quality assurance.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead technical planning, website architecture, and solution design.
  • Conduct discovery sessions, technical assessments, and stakeholder workshops.
  • Design information architecture, sitemap structure, and user journeys.
  • Lead UX/UI strategy to optimize visitor engagement and usability.
  • Develop and configure custom WordPress themes and functionality.
  • Implement responsive, mobile-first website design standards.
  • Integrate third-party applications, APIs, analytics, and interactive maps.
  • Ensure website scalability, security, and performance optimization.
  • Collaborate with content and SEO teams to support destination marketing objectives.
  • Oversee accessibility implementation and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance activities.
  • Conduct technical reviews, testing, and quality assurance validation.
  • Support website launch, staff training, and knowledge transfer activities.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout maintenance and enhancement activities.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in website development and digital solutions.
  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on WordPress development experience.
  • Experience leading enterprise or tourism-focused website redesign projects.
  • Experience implementing API integrations, analytics, and custom functionality.
  • Demonstrated experience with responsive design and UX best practices.
  • Experience supporting website hosting, maintenance, and security updates.
  • Experience working with public sector, tourism, destination marketing, or municipal organizations preferred.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Web Development, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field.
  • WordPress Development certifications preferred.
  • UX Design or Human-Centered Design certifications preferred.
  • Google Analytics certification preferred.

Compensation: $45.00 – $55.00 per hour
